race.comment: ESMAHLI (1) looks very well placed back in grade off two good runs this time in. He ran on well behind a smart one fresh at Caulfield Heath then battled well on heavy ground behind a dominant winner at Flemington. Looks very hard to hold out here. ONAVUITTON (9) resumes. His form tapered off at the end of last campaign but fourth to Observer in a G2 Autumn Stakes says he's right up to this, watch the betting. CHARMING NIC (2) struggled on the heavy at Flemington but had won well prior and can bounce back. INSAIN HARRY (8) is coming off solid win at Geelong and warrants respect from a soft gate.
